notes: Plain-text 10-K for the fiscal year ended January 3, 1998. The contents list (lines 62 to 79) is not labeled; Items 1 to 14 each have one body heading. An unnumbered 'EXCUTIVE OFFICERS' section stays in Item 1. Item 8 only points to the statements on page F-3 and Item 9 says 'None.', and Items 10 to 13 only incorporate the proxy statement, so they are marked incorporated; Item 4 ('No matters were submitted') is an answer and is not. Item 14 ends at the company-name line above the index to the statements (line 1247): the statements at pages F-2 to F-15 follow with no Item heading and belong to no Item, as in the Netflix 2003 and Vesta 2003 labels. There is no signatures heading, so the filing ends at the signature block's opening sentence, 'PURSUANT TO THE REQUIREMENTS ...' (line 2025); the 'Signature' at line 2053 is a column header. Item 7A has no heading and is not listed absent, following the Allen Organ 1998 label (fiscal 1997, small company), since market risk disclosure was not yet required of a company this size; the fresh3 Cellular Communications of Puerto Rico 1998 label would list it absent because the form defined it at filing. The absent list is not scored.
